2609.29278.title: Reasoning Instructions Can Break Answer Decoding in Vision--Language Models
2609.29278.paper_summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) instructions can distort multiple-choice VLM evaluation when a scorer appends a reasoning cue but reads answer-label logits before the model generates any rationale. We call this CoT-prefix scoring. On ScienceQA, Qwen2.5-VL-7B drops from 80.76% to 45.48%, and across five option-content permutations 93.54% of CoT-prefix predictions select the first slot. Condition-matched linear probes recover 78.94% from the same hidden states, while free generation restores 75.24%, showing that the answer often survives the prefix and the immediate readout fails. Vocabulary and layer diagnostics explain the mismatch: probability mass moves toward continuation tokens, while answer information remains linearly accessible in late layers. The effect recurs with varying severity across datasets and models, though not universally. These results show that CoT-prefix scoring can confound model knowledge with an evaluation-interface mismatch and should be avoided unless the requested and scored output events are aligned.
2609.29278.paper_summary_zh: Chain-of-thought (CoT) 指令在評估多選擇 VLM 時可能會扭曲結果，當評分者附加推理提示但在模型生成任何理由之前閱讀答案標籤的 logits。我們稱這種情況為 CoT-prefix 評分。在 ScienceQA 上，Qwen2.5-VL-7B 的分數從 80.76% 降至 45.48%，而在五個選項內容的排列中，93.54% 的 CoT-prefix 預測選擇了第一個槽位。條件匹配的線性探針從相同的隱藏狀態中恢復了 78.94%，而自由生成恢復了 75.24%，顯示答案通常在前綴中存活，而即時的讀取失敗。詞彙和層診斷解釋了這種不匹配：概率質量向延續標記移動，而答案信息在後期層中保持線性可訪問。這種效應在不同數據集和模型中以不同的嚴重程度重現，儘管並非普遍存在。這些結果顯示，CoT-prefix 評分可能會因評估介面不匹配而混淆模型知識，除非請求和評分的輸出事件對齊，否則應避免使用。
